title: Drawing approval
passage:
Who can approve this revised drawing?
A. It was revised yesterday.
B. Three printed copies.
C. The design lead can approve it.
passageZh:
誰能核准這張修訂後的圖面？
A. 昨天修訂的。
B. 三份印刷本。
C. 設計負責人可以核准。
